meta.name: pop-up-book-illustration
meta.description: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画，具备立体层次感、明亮温暖色调，适用于科技、教育、品牌展示等场景

copy.tagline: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中加入立体纸艺风格的视觉元素
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D papercraft style visuals to your projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按3D纸艺弹出书风格生成插画，包含纸质纹理、立体层次、薄荷绿/天蓝等明亮色调，并可融入数字科技元素。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成具有纸艺质感、立体层次和明亮温暖色调的插画时触发。

say.text: 用薄荷绿和天蓝色画一张科技主题的弹出书插画
say.note: 会生成带霓虹光效的纸艺风格图

say.text: 画一本弹出书，中间是知识树，用珊瑚橙和奶油黄配色
say.note: 适合教育主题的立体纸艺图

say.text: 把品牌产品放进弹出书插画，周围加品牌关键词
say.note: 生成产品展示风格的立体纸艺图

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate illustrations in a 3D paper-art pop-up book style, featuring paper texture, layered depth, bright tones like mint green and sky blue, and can blend in digital tech elements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for an illustration with paper-art texture, layered depth, and bright warm tones.

say_en.text: Create a tech-themed pop-up book illustration in mint green and sky blue
say_en.note: Will include soft neon glow effects

say_en.text: Draw a pop-up book with a knowledge tree in coral orange and cream yellow
Put a brand product inside a pop-up book scene with brand keywords around it
